mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 带我们从阳光层一路潜入暮光层，认识海洋的分层与生命。仿写训练精选课文金句，练‘倒装、分词状语、定语从句’三类高分句式的迁移。

items.focusType: 地点状语前置 + 完全倒装
items.focus: 把表示方位/地点的状语提到句首，谓语(lie/stand/sit/come 等不及物动词)提到主语前，制造画面感与强调。注意：主语是代词时不倒装。
items.original: Here lives much of the marine life we know about, such as dolphins, corals and seaweeds.
items.cn: 我们所知的大部分海洋生物就生活在这里——比如海豚、珊瑚和海藻。

models.en: In the heart of the old forest stood a lonely cabin, half hidden by ivy.
Beyond the harbour lay the open sea, glittering under the setting sun.

items.tip: 谓语必须是不及物动词(lie/stand/sit 等)时才用完全倒装；若主语是 it/he 等代词则语序不变。

items.focusType: 现在分词短语作状语 + where 定语从句
items.focus: 用 V-ing 短语开头作伴随/时间状语，再用 where 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明地点。
items.original: Sinking below 200 metres, we enter the twilight zone, where there is little sunlight and thus almost no plant life.
items.cn: 下潜到 200 米以下，我们便进入暮光层——那里阳光稀少，因而几乎没有植物。

models.en: Stepping into the ancient temple, we entered another age, where time seemed to stand still.
Climbing above the clouds, the plane broke into a world of pure blue, where nothing but sunlight remained.

items.tip: 分词的逻辑主语要与主句主语一致(Sinking 的是 we)，否则就成了‘垂悬分词’。

items.focusType: 现在分词后置定语 + which 定语从句
items.focus: 名词后先用 V-ing 短语作后置定语，再叠加一个 which/who 引导的定语从句，一句话交代‘是谁 + 在做什么’。
items.original: Most of the fish living here are small filter feeders which swim up at night to feed in the nutrient-rich waters above.
items.cn: 生活在这里的鱼大多是小型滤食动物，它们夜间上浮，到上方营养丰富的水域觅食。

models.en: Most of the students sitting in the front row are eager learners who stay after class to ask questions.
The birds nesting on the cliff are hardy survivors which brave even the fiercest storms.

items.tip: living here 相当于 that live here；后置定语与定语从句可叠用，但别让句子头重脚轻。
